text: Meeting deadlines is a skill that requires good time management. Start by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting personal milestones. Prioritize your workload—identify what is urgent or important, and focus on those tasks first. Scope management is also key; avoid adding extra features or tasks once work begins, as this can delay completion. Finally, communicate early with your team or manager if you foresee issues. A quick message can help adjust expectations or find solutions, preventing last-minute problems. With these strategies, you can handle deadlines more calmly and effectively.
